blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — oral dantrolene hepatic monitoring
stem: A client receives oral dantrolene for chronic spasticity. Which monitoring plan is supported by the current prescribing information?

options.A: Obtain baseline liver-function studies, repeat hepatic testing at appropriate intervals, and promptly evaluate symptoms compatible with hepatitis or jaundice during therapy.
options.B: Omit hepatic assessment after treatment begins because oral dantrolene is not associated with clinically important liver injury when used for chronic spasticity.
options.C: Focus monitoring on cardiac rhythm rather than hepatic function because clinically significant liver toxicity is not a recognized adverse effect of oral dantrolene.
options.D: Treat normal baseline liver tests as proof that later hepatotoxicity will not occur, so additional hepatic laboratory or symptom assessment is unnecessary.

rationale: Current oral dantrolene labeling warns that fatal and nonfatal liver disorders can occur. It recommends liver-function studies at the start of therapy to establish a baseline and repeat testing at appropriate intervals. If symptoms compatible with hepatitis occur with abnormal liver tests or jaundice, dantrolene should be discontinued. Therefore A is correct.
educational_objective: Monitor oral dantrolene therapy with baseline and interval liver-function assessment and prompt evaluation of symptoms suggesting hepatic injury because clinically important hepatotoxicity can occur.
source_version_date: DailyMed updated May 12, 2026; current label accessed 2026-08-26
source_locator: Warnings: fatal/nonfatal liver disorders may occur; obtain baseline liver-function studies at start of therapy; repeat at appropriate intervals; discontinue if symptoms compatible with hepatitis occur with abnormal liver tests or jaundice.
source_claim_supported: Oral dantrolene can cause serious hepatotoxicity and requires baseline and interval hepatic monitoring plus evaluation of hepatitis/jaundice symptoms.
blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies: monitor medication-related laboratory values and recognize serious adverse effects during chronic therapy.
candidate_reasons_resolved: Removed only-based cueing and balanced all choices as complete monitoring plans.
